title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Ice from Double Brew is a vibrant and delicious e-liquid that marries the tropical tang of ripe Pineapple with a bracing cool finish. This sweet and icy blend delivers a sun-soaked tropical taste sensation enhanced by a refreshing arctic breeze, elevating your vaping experience to delicious new dimensions. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the perfect sweet spot between flavour and cloud production, while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. They’re best used with high-resistance coils (0.8ohm-1.2ohm) for both RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) and MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experiences. Nic Salts are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids thanks to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. Nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration. Double Brew, from legendary vape-makers Ohm Brew, are a collection of sixteen double concentrate nic salts that will push you beyond your wildest flavour fantasies. They use twice the brew for twice the flavour, resulting in a unique vaping experience that’s twice as satisfying as any Nic Salt e-liquid you’ve ever tasted. Treat your tongue to double the deliciousness with Double Brew Nic Salts available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic strengths.
